AI Video Editor 1.2.0 — first release

- Proactively handles any video editing, clipping, highlight reel, or short-form video request using the Sparki.io API.
- Supports automated upload, AI-powered project creation, video processing, and delivery of a 24-hour download URL.
- Key features: Copy Style, Long-to-Short, AI Caption, AI Commentary, Video Resizer, Highlights, Vlog, Montage, Talking-head.
- Requires SPARKI_API_KEY setup; detailed instructions provided for quick onboarding.
- Includes robust scripts and workflows for upload, processing, and status checking of videos up to 3 GB.
